mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.0% triggers a central bank response to stimulate the economy, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0% but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in >60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate collapsing consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) during supply chain disruptions indicates reduced economic output, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO declines by >1.0% consecutively but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.0% signals robust economic expansion, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth >2.0% but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in >60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.0% indicates accelerating inflation, prompting monetary tightening that drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3.0% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in unemployment (UNRATE) and declines in payrolls (PAYEMS) signal labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls simultaneously but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) during a monetary tightening cycle indicates policy hawkishness, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises by >0.25% monthly but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of such instances.
